title: Drupal 7 end-of-life: a checklist for clients still on it
lede: Drupal 7 went unsupported in January 2025. The sites still humming along on it in mid-2026 are not unsupported by accident, they are unsupported by neglect.
hero_alt: Closed leather logbook with silk ribbon, brass pen nib on red wax seal, dated card on dark oak desk.
